task: Write an email to your friend about your summer holiday plans. Describe where you will go and what you will do.
studentDraft: Hi Jason, How are you? I want to tell you about my summer holiday plans. I will go to Japan with my family in July. We will visit Tokyo and Osaka. I am very exciting about this trip because I never go to Japan before. We will eat sushi and visit temples. I think the weather will be hot but I don't mind. My sister want to go shopping in Shibuya. We also plan to go to Universal Studios. I hope we can see the cherry blossoms but I think it is not the right season. Please write back and tell me your plans! Your friend, Amy.
